notes.title: Demo v0.7.5 Live + New Trailer! Celebrating Six One Indie Breakout Selection
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,[/b]

[h2]📢 New Demo + New Trailer[/h2]

[b]Demo v0.7.5[/b] is live! And we're celebrating [b]Gloomy Juncture[/b] being selected as a [b]breakout [/b]game for [b]Six One Indie[/b]!

They invited me to make an introduction... Big mistake. Anyway, check it out and don't blink, because you might miss important details... 🐈🔫 

Here's the [b]presentation[/b], [b]featuring Link the Black Cat[/b], and followed by the [b]New Official Trailer[/b]:
[previewyoutube=waVpX6GQH_M;full][/previewyoutube]

The showcase was streamed live on Six One Indie, IGN, GameSpot & GameTrailers, [url=https://youtu.be/QncfsZr_fxQ?t=2684]here's the whole showcase[/url] (Gloomy Juncture starts at 44m44s) - still can't believe it 👀

But if you like it spicy, I've also released the [b]uncensored version[/b] of the trailer on YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bfGYIvn9wKYhttps://youtu.be/bfGYIvn9wKY

[h2]General Demo Changes[/h2]

[h3][ FEATURES ][/h3]
[list]
[*] Scrollable Inventory: Mouse scroll will equip/unequip the last selected item (or most recent if none is selected)
[*] Toggle Puzzles will now auto equip the required item (if nothing is equipped) when the player wrongfully tries a 'Normal Interaction' (e.g., 'Peculiar Crystal Boxes')
[/list]
[h3][ IMPROVEMENTS ][/h3]
[list]
[*] A few interactable titles changed to better fit the narrative
[*] Added extra and alternative narration lines of different types, such as: item pickup feedback, focus on interactables, and dynamic events
[*] New Office Computer shader effect with new animation improvements
[*] The Cretin remains interactable while looking at TV (the behavior will change on full release with new animations and dialog lines)
[*] Puzzle Solved sfx/jingle no longer plays when interacting with Toggle Puzzles (e.g., 'Peculiar Crystal Boxes')
[/list]
[h3][ FIXES ][/h3]
[list]
[*] A bug that sometimes prevented the Item name to appear on the hint UI at the first interaction
[*] A very rare bug in Dragon Dungeon that incorrectly showed the key as not picked
[/list]
 
If you want to reach out, [b]join us on Discord[/b]:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Xh5qY7W7fX]https://discord.com/invite/Xh5qY7W7fX[/url]

I'd love to hear your thoughts and get all your feedback.

Cheers,
Filipe

notes.title: Gloomy Juncture Chinese Localization & Finalist at Tencent GWB Awards 2024
notes.content:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

[h3]📢 Exciting Announcement![/h3]

Gloomy Juncture is now available in Simplified Chinese, celebrating its selection for the GWB Game Awards 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/955191901240aa59e83cf996e286f8c869fb5172.gif[/img]

Chinese localization has been a long-requested feature, and I apologize for the slow release. As a solo developer handling the localization process, strategic language selection takes considerable time and effort.

I want to sincerely thank Huang "Shuyuan" Teng for translating Gloomy Juncture into Simplified Chinese and for being the person responsible for introducing me and Gloomy Juncture to the Chinese market. 🙏

I'd love to get your feedback on the demo and translation, either [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdGpTsCLH_fmuCkUjj3cb7ODogq3lXHVW-Fxp2oKktTNWw9SA/viewform]on this form[/url] or by [url=https://discord.gg/Xh5qY7W7fX]joining the Discord here[/url] 🤘

Tune in to see if Gloomy Juncture wins any award today, November 22, at 16:30 UTC on the Steam page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GWBGameAwards2024]GWB Game Awards 2024[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GWBGameAwards2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/556e29992ba66c98ebf6d497eb26875eecb9b80b.jpg[/img][/url]

The awards ceremony runs for 24 hours, so no worries if you miss the launch!

Thank you,
Filipe

notes.title: New Gloomy Juncture Demo – Major Update (Shift to Run) & Discord Server Live!
notes.content:
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture,

I’m excited to announce that [b]Demo v0.7.2[/b] of Gloomy Juncture is now live! Thanks to the incredible feedback I've received from the Tiny Teams 2024 community (a huge shoutout to all the new players) and the insights from the Indie Cup Europe '24 jurors, I’ve been working hard to apply a new layer of polish, improvements, and quality-of-life updates to the game and demo.

This update brings the Gloomy Juncture demo closer to it's final experience, and It would mean a lot to me if you gave it a try. Whether you’re discovering it for the first time or returning for another playthrough, I’m confident you'll notice a more refined and immersive experience.

[h3]Gloomy Juncture v0.7.2[/h3]
The update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added new Splash Screen & Intro Credits.
[*] Revamped the game's introduction to clarify the setting, story and player objectives.
[*] Introduced new voice narrations as subtle hints, triggered by interactions and events.
[*] Added new voice narrations to provide deeper insight into the game world.
[*] New remarks from the cretin to enhance the world and player understanding of the setting.
[*] New voice narrations for the Wrong Usage of items. More intuitive voiceovers that enhance gameplay feedback.
[*] Refined the puzzle design and clarity with updated assets, improved interfaces and enhanced visual/audio cues. Providing clearer feedback on player actions and progress. Some specific puzzle enhancements include:
    • Power Panel: Updated interface with intuitive animations and a progress indicator.
    • Dragon Dungeon: Implemented a new AI system for a more strategic gameplay.
    • Fortune Teller: Enhanced the pipe-following by adding shadow projections on pipes, improving depth perception and reducing frustration.
[*] New RUN feature. Press Shift to move faster (key binding can be changed). 
[*] Head Bobbing during run can be toggled on/off in Settings.
[*] Updated journal entries and inventory item descriptions for a better fit within the game's atmosphere.
[*] Added new assets and models as subtle enhancements, designed to enrich the narrative atmosphere without directly affecting gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue where journal entries were not scaling correctly with certain screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player character would occasionally move for a few frames before stopping when a cutscene was triggered.
[*] Improved 3D audio distance attenuation on certain objects. 
[*] Improved shadows to better align with maximum gamma and brightness settings, ensuring visual consistency across different screens and configurations.
[*] Improved interactions with certain game objects, reducing frustration caused by obstructions and awkward angles.
[*] Enhanced some Japanese translations for improved clarity and accuracy.
[/list]
[h3]Discord Server[/h3]
I've also (finally) created a Discord server. Please feel free to join if you want to hangout, provide feedback on this new update, or even help me with playtesting.
Note: I'll be providing beta keys as soon as new builds are ready to test. 

Discord Invite Link: https://discord.gg/Xh5qY7W7fX


Hope to see your feedback on Discord.

Thank you,
Filipe

notes.title: Gloomy Juncture Demo Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/55196517791d4dc7caaa5a742f2e637dc6272164.jpg[/img]
Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture!

[h2]NEW DEMO LAUNCH[/h2]

[b]I'm excited to announce that the new demo of Gloomy Juncture is officially live![/b]

This version features numerous quality-of-life improvements based on the valuable feedback you guys provided from the first public demo. Please note that some features, like the much-requested Run feature and even more diegetic tips (narration), are still not included in this demo. For instance, running still needs tweaks as it's integrated into some more action-oriented puzzles.

I've also refined gameplay mechanics, enhanced puzzles, and made several visual upgrades to textures and assets.

[h3]NOTABLE IMPROVEMENTS IN THE DEMO[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revised interaction system - tighter controls and smoother animations, providing a more responsive experience when interacting with items and the environment.
[*] New HUD showing multiple interaction tips.
[*] Multiple improvements to Inventory/Journal interface, experience, and general interactions.
[*] Refactored cleaning puzzle - now providing a sense of progression with incremental usage and new assets, giving a more immersive experience.
[*] A whole new Cretin! But don't worry, his old self will be forever immortalized in the office painting!
[/list]
I'm looking forward to your feedback!

[h2]JAPANESE LOCALIZATION[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/7525b687ec4cefde57397aca0b3283fe02d69d81.jpg[/img]
In preparation for BitSummit Drift, Gloomy Juncture is now fully translated into Japanese! I'm thrilled to receive feedback about this weird work from a whole new audience across the seas.

[h2]BitSummit Drift[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/87d12054ab7ff9bdac4531a2e9c6e82dfa7335ad.jpg[/img]
If you happen to be around Kyoto, pay a visit to booth H-08, where my friend Laura Teixeira will be representing Gloomy Juncture. Not only did Laura help with the Japanese translation, but this is also her first showcase event. Show her some support if you can!

[h2]Japanese Poster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/9ba7306adf8154821e15bc3469a15c2fd4739ebe.jpg[/img]

Hope to hear from you soon.

Thank you so much for all your support,
Filipe

notes.title: 🕵‍♂️ Gloomy Juncture in Japan! 🚀
notes.content:
[i]Hello, dear inhabitants of this Gloomy Juncture.[/i]

[h3]Gloomy Juncture Selected for BitSummit Drift![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/357c0ffd35bf6b0663d3189fb72d5095d87e4367.jpg[/img]
I'm very honored to announce that Gloomy Juncture has been chosen to showcase at BitSummit, Japan’s longest-running indie games festival! 

[b]Event Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Dates:[/b] July 19-21, 2024
[*] [b]Location:[/b] MIYAKO MESSE 3rd Exhibition Hall, 3F, Kyoto
[*] [b]My Booth:[/b] H-08
[*] [b]Features:[/b] Music performances, talk panels, interviews with industry veterans from around the world[/list]
BitSummit is a great opportunity for the selected indies, as the event will be featured on the frontpage of Steam in Japan for the duration of the event! There's also a chance to win an award (more on this below), and it's my pleasure to also announce that Gloomy Juncture's Steam page is now fully translated to Japanese!

[b][i]This Portuguese gloomy tale awaits you in Kyoto [/i][/b]

[h3]Popular Selection Award[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/0cfe6fd9398aa686030342b77c9666deb9e3d374.png[/img]
BitSummit's Award Show isn't just for the judges. Among the 10 awards, the [b]BitSummit Popular Selection Award[/b] will be decided by the attendees.

Here's how you can vote:
[list]
[*] Find voting stickers in your white BitSummit welcome bag
[*] Locate the voting board in front of the main stage
[*] Place your sticker in the column for your favorite game
[/list]
If Gloomy Juncture has captured your heart, I'd be honored to receive your vote!

[url=https://bitsummit.org/en/awards-2/]Learn more about the BitSummit awards here[/url]

[h3]More good news, everyone![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758844/3a98f2d3a2ffeffb84d042987d7a02bd707b8780.jpg[/img]
Can't make it to BitSummit? I've got you covered! A [b]new demo[/b] is dropping [b]during the Steam event[/b], packed with QoL updates based on your valuable feedback. I'll be sharing more about these improvements in a dedicated post, so keep an eye out for that.

Oh, and by the way... yes, it'll be localized in Japanese too! 😱

[b]🔥 Wishlist Gloomy Juncture now to stay updated on the BitSummit journey and be notified when the new demo goes live! 🔥[/b]

Make sure to follow [url=https://x.com/SubtalesStudio]@SubtalesStudio on Twitter/X[/url] for the latest updates!

[b]More about BitSummit Drift[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://bitsummit.org/12th/en/]Program Schedule[/url]
[*] [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/venue-2/]Venue Map[/url]
[*] [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/games/]Selected Games[/url]
[*] [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/game/gloomy-juncture/]Gloomy Juncture (English)[/url]
[*] [url=https://bitsummit.org/game/gloomy-juncture-2/]Gloomy Juncture (Japanese)[/url]
[/list]
I'm thrilled to showcase my weird work in Kyoto, and the chance to share Gloomy Juncture with a new audience. Your encouragement means everything, and I can't wait to share more updates with you all!

Stay tuned, and keep it gloomy...
Thank you,
Filipe
